classes.purpose: Select and order approved scenes and write source-faithful narration
classes.content: Research scene images; supplied reports, figures, maps, statistics, labels and qualifications; source-basis references; audience, story objective and scene order

classes.purpose: Prepare, review and validate the narrated research video
classes.content: Scene plan, narration, visual fingerprints, motion choices, approval record, captions, timing, render report, media QA, caveats and final review findings

boundaries_beyond_codex.destination: OpenAI Audio API through the user's local OPENAI_API_KEY
boundaries_beyond_codex.purpose: Synthesize the approved English narration as scene-level voice-over audio
boundaries_beyond_codex.content: Only the exact approved narration text and fixed voice instructions; scene images, source-basis notes, source files and local paths are not transmitted by the renderer
controls: Preparation performs no network call and writes the exact narration and source-basis review packet first.
Rendering fails unless approval is bound to the current scene plan, narration script, review packet and visual file hashes.
The API key is read only from the local environment and is never written to commands, logs or artifacts.
The fixed renderer request sends narration text only and never opens or uploads scene images or source-basis records.

security_controls.control: The renderer verifies the approved plan, narration script, review packet and every visual SHA-256 before any speech request.
Scene images and optional foreground layers are opened only by the local renderer and are not included in the OpenAI speech request.
